name: Zeyi Li
title: HKUMed Bachelor ’29
summary: I connect healthcare, communication, business, technology, and creative work. My experience spans programme operations, cross-border e-commerce, international health-sciences collaboration, and public speaking.

entries.title: The University of Hong Kong
entries.role: Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine

entries.title: Cross-border E-commerce
bullets: Advanced brand building and completed trademark registration with the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).
Independently planned and launched an Amazon store for the North American market, covering market research, product selection, and platform entry.
Monitored sales volume, traffic, and conversion data to inform business strategy.
Maintained ACoS below 30% and TACoS up to 21% through promotional content, store-page optimisation, and analysis of feedback data.

entries.title: HKU Admissions Office
bullets: Managed programme operations for HKU Academy for the Talented (ACT), including participant administration, application processing, and visa tracking across international academic programmes.
Coordinated programme logistics and academic events with cross-functional stakeholders, supporting communication with international students through admissions and onboarding.
Reconciled admissions datasets, identified operational discrepancies, and streamlined administrative workflows.

entries.title: Amazon.com & International Trade Company
bullets: Created A+ advertising content and organised advertising data for an Amazon best-seller.
Analysed Amazon store data to inform advertising strategies and cost optimisation.
Coordinated international shipping and supply-chain workflows, including inventory turnover, order fulfilment, and operational costs.

entries.title: U21 Health Sciences Group International Programme 2026
bullets: Selected to represent The University of Hong Kong, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams from global universities.
Developed evidence-based responses to global healthcare challenges through research, cross-cultural teamwork, stakeholder engagement, and presentations.
Presented policy recommendations and project outcomes to an international academic audience.

entries.title: Orbis Vision Leader Program 2025/26
bullets: Participated in public-health and international charity projects.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop community outreach plans.

entries.title: Hong Kong International Nursing Forum & HKU School of Nursing 30th Anniversary
entries.role: Master of Ceremony and Student Ambassador
bullets: Served as master of ceremony for the opening dinner, coordinating with senior alumni.
Provided on-site support and guest reception services at the forum.

entries.title: China-Latin American Literature Roundtable Dialogue
entries.role: Invited Roundtable Speaker · Consulate of Colombia & Global Times
bullets: Delivered a keynote speech on Sino-Latin American literary exchanges.
Joined roundtable discussions with the Colombian Ambassador on international relations and cultural cooperation.
